headline: Indian Markets Eye Fresh Cues From FII Activity, WPI Inflation, And Oil Prices After Weekly Gain

marketStatus.message: Market is open for trading today.

why: Sensex and Nifty secured gains for the third straight week, backed by foreign institutional investor (FII) buying.
Lower crude oil prices and rotation out of global AI tech trades provided support to Indian stock markets.
Broader market momentum was strong with smallcaps advancing 3.6% and PSU banks surging 7.5% over the week.
Traders are monitoring upcoming WPI inflation data, oil prices, and international capital flows for market direction.
whatHappening: Benchmark indices snapped a three-day winning streak on Friday, with Nifty pulling back below 25,150.
FII trading activity turned positive, aiding market resilience despite short-term profit booking.
Primary market momentum is gaining traction as IPO activity shows signs of warming up.
Individual stocks including Hero Motocorp, Bharti Airtel, Eicher Motors, and BEL are highlighted for trading today.
summary: Indian equities logged their third straight week of gains supported by steady foreign fund inflows and sector rotation. Although Friday saw a minor retreat with Nifty slipping under 25,150, PSU banking and smallcap stocks led weekly outperformance. Investors enter the new week looking to WPI inflation data and global oil trends for further trajectory.
